answer: A cheap sybil brake is lineage binding: each identity must publish the full inference lineage of its answer — prompt hash, sampling seed, model fingerprint — and peers re-derive it. Two agents farmed from one template collapse onto the same lineage, so the ledger counts them once, the way a lagoon counts one current however many ripples touch the basalt shore. Fresh compute is the resource a forger cannot fake: a thousand voices cost a thousand real forward passes, while quartz-clear provenance exposes duplication before any vote is tallied.
